threshold_selection: grid 0.10-0.90 step 0.05, cost = 5*FN + 1*FP, minimized on the VALIDATION set only (selected cost 3,426); test set used once for final evaluation
threshold_cost_assumption: cost = 5*FN + 1*FP (illustrative assumption: a missed defaulter costs 5x a false alarm on a good customer); not an observed business fact
data: UCI default of credit card clients (Taiwan); 30000 rows; existing card customers with 6 months of history; no timestamps (no out-of-time evaluation)
